description: This file defines the PayGradeDao class, which provides data access methods for PayGrade and related entities such as PayGradeCurrency, CurrencyType, and PayPeriod within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, filtering, saving, and deleting pay grade data, as well as handling currency associations for pay grades.

classes.name: PayGradeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling database operations related to pay grades, pay grade currencies, and related entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getPayGradeById
methods.description: Retrieves a PayGrade entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingPayGradeIds
methods.description: Fetches existing pay grade IDs from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getPayGradeList
methods.description: Returns a list of pay grades matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPayGradesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for pay grade listing with applied filters and sorting.

methods.name: getCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Gets list of currency associations for a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for pay grade currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of pay grade currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Counts the total number of pay grade currencies matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches a specific pay grade currency record based on currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: getPayPeriods
methods.description: Returns a list of all pay periods.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Returns a list of all currency types.

methods.name: getCurrencyById
methods.description: Retrieves a currency type by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCurrencyIdsForPayGradeId
methods.description: Finds existing currency IDs associated with a pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradesCount
methods.description: Counts the total pay grades matching filter criteria.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Persists a PayGrade entity to the database.

methods.name: savePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Persists a PayGradeCurrency entity.

methods.name: deletePayGrades
methods.description: Deletes multiple pay grades by their IDs.

methods.name: deletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Deletes specific currency associations for a pay grade.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves currencies that are allowed for a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of allowed pay currencies for a pay grade.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for allowed pay currencies based on filter parameters.
